Ana (Partnerships): Quick preflight — we have Snow + Databricks + 2 vector DB partners lined up for a joint marketplace listing and coordinated announcement. Need a concrete technical handoff + runbook before Thu EOD. Who owns which artifacts? cc @Sam @Ravi @Mateo

Sam (Eng-Platform): I'm taking platform items. High level checklist: 1) connector binary + manifest, 2) acceptance tests (smoke + perf), 3) marketplace package metadata (icons/screenshots/README), 4) sample datasets + ingest script, 5) deployment policy (regions+billing tags), 6) model/version pins for compatibility. PR draft: https://git.redwood.ai/r/integrations/connector-snow-dbx/pull/432 

Sam (Eng-Platform): Smoke run snippet to add to runbook:
```
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --connector snow-dbx --samples ./samples/
pytest tests/acceptance/test_smoke.py::TestConnectorSmoke -k snow
```

Ravi (Solutions): I'll own sample data + eval prompts. Need multi-tenant redaction rules and a tiny corpus for perf so partners can run locally. ETA Tue noon. Also putting together a short demo notebook (Jupyter) that shows query -> embedding -> vector search -> upsert.

Mateo (Partner-SI): SI enablement plan: 1) training deck, 2) lab env (terraform + quickstart), 3) triage + escalation doc. Scheduling 2 office hours (Wed 15:00 UTC, Thu 08:00 PT). Also: hardware partners asked about packaging for on-prem appliances — what's our connector binary size target? :thinking_face:

Sam (Eng-Platform): Target is <= 200MB for marketplace zip. Currently connector runtime ~150MB gzipped. For on-prem we do sidecar container (docs incoming). Will add build artifact location to PR.

Ana (Partnerships): Legal/logo approvals? Partners want to preview the announcement assets. Elaine, will trademark check block the timeline? :exclamation:

Elaine (Legal): We need partner logo usage approvals and signed co-marketing addendum. If assets are final, trademark review + asset approval usually ~48 hours. NDA extension for one partner still pending — pinged them this morning.

Mateo (Partner-SI): Noted. I'll delay announcement draft until we get logo approvals. Meanwhile I'll share the SI deck and lab terraform in the runbook.

Sam (Eng-Platform): One more tech item: acceptance matrix we expect partners to run before we certify:
- Basic connectivity (ingest + query)
- Schema mapping test (nested fields)
- KV cache warmup perf (95p latency)
- Fault injection (simulated network blips)
I'll add scripts under `tests/partner_acceptance/` and a `verify.sh` wrapper.

Ravi (Solutions): I'll map those to the sample dataset and write 5 turnkey prompts for quality checks. Also adding a short checklist for data residency requirements per region.

Ana (Partnerships): Great. Can everyone add their status to the shared runbook doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/partners/marketplace/preflight — include owner, ETA, blocker. I want a go/no-go by Thu 17:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Reminder: marketplace dry-run (internal) scheduled 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC — will attempt a full package upload to staging marketplace.

Sam (Eng-Platform): Added build + staging upload steps to runbook. Staging bucket: `s3://redwood-marketplace-staging/connectors/2026-03-24/` . Please make sure artifacts follow `manifest.yaml` schema.

Mateo (Partner-SI): SI office hours invites going out now. Will attach a short run-through deck and an optional lab sign-up link.

Elaine (Legal): I'll fast-track logo review once you drop final assets in the doc. Also note: co-marketing addendum needs signature before public announcement.

Ana (Partnerships): Good. Quick blockers check — everyone reply with single-line status: green/yellow/red + brief note.

Sam (Eng-Platform): green — PR up, tests scaffolded, need partner infra creds for perf runs.

Ravi (Solutions): yellow — sample dataset done, waiting on redaction rules from partner, should be clear by Tue noon.

Mateo (Partner-SI): green — SI deck + lab infra ready, office hours scheduled.

Elaine (Legal): yellow — NDA extension pending, logos queued for review.

Ana (Partnerships): Perfect. I'll consolidate and send a short preflight to the partners. Thanks team :thumbsup:
